method: Read-only source and supplied fresh runtime-evidence review
verified_remediations: CatalogCell centers text vertically and provides 8-point horizontal inset for all collection columns; selected sample/plugin captures agree.
Root rows now use TopAlignedDocument and appear at the top of their scroll region.
Setup rerenders after folder edits restore focus to the category Add action; smoke records long-folder removal focus.
Inspector title is bounded and has full-name tooltip; long plugin capture keeps Show in Finder visible.
Save failure remains visible alongside session-only recovery and Back/Save actions.
Progress track exposes native accessibility progress role, minimum, maximum and updated numeric value.
Runtime evidence records browsing inventory while reference analysis continues; source copy explains background work.

Long-folder sheet remains 740 points wide; path labels truncate within the viewport, Remove buttons stay visible, and native smoke asserts width <= 741. Fresh setup-long-folders capture confirms repair.
Sidebar controls explicitly remain enabled with semantic labelColor content tint; native smoke asserts navigation enabled.
nonblocking_observations: No Stop action remains, although incremental inventory resolves the original all-results-held-until-finish problem.
Remove accessibility labels still use basename only, so equal basenames should receive path context in accessibility help.
Current native checks still do not establish complete tab traversal or screen-reader announcements.
limits: This reviewer did not rerun the app or operate VoiceOver
Do not interpret source review and supplied smoke as complete assistive-technology certification

resolved_findings.finding: Long folder names force the setup sheet to expand far beyond its intended width and parent window instead of truncating within the viewport.
resolved_findings.evidence: setup-long-folders.png shows a sheet about twice the designed 740-point width, extending beyond both sides of the main window; the full synthetic path dominates the row.
resolved_findings.root_mechanism: Path labels participate in intrinsic-width layout without explicit low horizontal compression resistance; parent constraints allow the sheet fitting size to expand.
resolved_findings.required_fix: Give path labels a low horizontal compression resistance, preserve Remove button width, and constrain the sheet content/root viewport to its intended width so byTruncatingMiddle takes effect.
resolved_findings.validation: Assert setup content width stays 740 points after adding 10 near-limit folder names. Capture at minimum parent width and verify every Remove button stays within the visible viewport, including after scrolling.
